selection_blinding: Frozen before any final-setting feasibility label, universal-model error, fine-tuned-model weight, fallback trajectory, or fallback DFT label existed. The publication test uses independent velocity seeds and is never used for training, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or model-family choice.
sampling_scope: Final fine-tuned-model trajectories generate a new model-relevant test distribution only; their transport estimates are not publication observations.
